text:
alex: Quick sync — can someone run a short cross-SKU microbench for long-context memory behavior? Need p50/p95/p99 latencies, peak GPU memory, and KV cache hit stats for A100 / H100 / L40S. Target model: gptx-13b-empirical. Prefer mixed batch sizes (1, 8, 32) and seq lens (128, 512, 2048).

maya: I can take A100 + L40S in us-west. Do we want quantized runs too (4-bit) or just fp16? :thinking_face:

alex: Start fp16 for parity, then a 4-bit sweep if time permits. Main objective: see where p99 spikes when we ramp batch and seq simultaneously. Also capture per-token time series if possible.

jc: I'll queue H100 in us-central. Can you paste the exact bench command to avoid env diffs?

alex: Use this wrapper so envs are consistent: 
```bash
./run_perf_sweep \
  --model=gptx-13b-empirical \
  --skus=h100,a100,l40s \
  --seq=128,512,2048 \
  --batch=1,8,32 \
  --quant=fp16 \
  --collect=latency,p99,p95,p50,gpu_mem,kv_hits,per_token_ts \
  --outdir=/tmp/bench_results/$SKU/$TS
```
Make sure to tag the job with `bench/hw-longctx` and attach the run_id to this thread.

samir: Small nit — for 2048 seq + batch 32 on L40S we might OOM. Add `--max-parallel=2` and a fallback `--fallback=reduce-batch` so it gracefully tries smaller batches.

maya: Good call. I'll add `--fallback=reduce-batch,quant=4bit` so if fp16 fails we try 4-bit.

bench-bot: job queued (id: 20260317001) on pool us-west (a100,l40s). ETA start ~ 12m.

jc: H100 started (job id: 20260317002). Noting driver 535.101 on that node, in case kernel changes matter.

alex: Awesome — when you have the raw CSV, include columns: sku, seq, batch, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, peak_gpu_mb, kv_hit_rate, run_id. We'll generate radar + heatmap later.

maya: A100 run finished quick check: p99 spikes ~2.8x at seq=2048 batch=32, peak GPU memory 39GB, kv_hit_rate 0.77. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-bench/tmp/20260317/a100-20260317.tgz

jc: H100 early results: p99 stable up to batch=8, but at batch=32 p99 jumps and we see microburst noise in per_token_ts. Peak mem 34GB. Uploading: s3://redwood-bench/tmp/20260317/h100-20260317.tgz

samir: L40S hit oom on the largest config, fallback triggered to batch=16 then batch=8. When on batch=8 p99 is comparable to A100 at seq=2048. Logs: s3://redwood-bench/tmp/20260317/l40s-20260317.tgz

alex: Great notes. Next steps: 1) jc/maya, please add the run_id and driver/kernel info to the CSV. 2) I'll run the analysis notebook on these s3 artifacts and post heatmaps by EOD. 3) If anyone sees a consistent per_token microburst pattern, flag hardware vs runtime kernel (attach strace/perf if you can).

maya: Added driver info to metadata file in the tarball. Also noted one node had older CUDA patch, see notes.txt inside.

jc: Will try a targeted kernel-variant run with `--kernel=alt_async_copy` to see if microbursts change. If so, we'll file kernel perf ticket.

alex: Perfect. Thanks all — tagging @benching for visibility. :thumbsup:
